import receiverlibrary.checkpoint
fun bad(): Int = checkpoint()

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
fun bad(scope: CoroutineScope, block: suspend CoroutineScope.() -> Int): Int = block(scope)

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
fun bad(): Int = runBlocking { value -> value }

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
fun bad(): String = runBlocking { 1 }

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
fun bad(): Int = runBlocking<Int> { "wrong" }

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
suspend fun bad(scope: CoroutineScope, block: (suspend CoroutineScope.() -> Int)?): Int = block(scope)

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
fun limited(block: CoroutineScope.() -> Int): Int = runBlocking(block = block)
fun limited(block: suspend Unit.() -> Int): Int = 1
suspend fun limited(value: Int = 1): Int = value

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
inline fun limited(noinline block: suspend CoroutineScope.() -> Int): Int = 1
